_about: Reviewed screening exceptions: RFC chunks a detector flagged that a person read and found to be ordinary RFC text. Each releases only that exact text (sha256), from that document, while no detector outside flagged_by objects. Written by scripts/review_quarantine.py.

exceptions.reason: RFC 9293 section 3.10.4-3.10.5: TCP CLOSE and ABORT call processing by state. The quoted strings ('error: connection illegal for this process') are error replies the TCP implementation returns to its user, not instructions to a model. Flagged by Prompt Guard 2 alone (0.71).

RFC 8446 Appendix C.3, Implementation Pitfalls: a checklist of questions addressed to TLS implementers ('do you correctly send an empty Certificate message...?'). Implementation guidance, not a task for a model. Flagged by the task policy alone.

RFC 8446 end of Appendix C.3 (implementer checklist), C.4 Client Tracking Prevention, C.5 Unauthenticated Operation and the start of Appendix D: normative SHOULD/MUST text for implementations. Flagged by the task policy alone.
